## Customer Story

**Customer:** BGL — SMSF administration software (12,700+ businesses, 15 countries)

**Challenge:** Business users dependent on data team for every analytics query, creating bottlenecks and delays

**Solution:** Slack-based AI agent that converts natural language to SQL to Python analytics, powered by Claude Agent SDK on a strong data foundation
